terminal_blockers.problem: tts_runtime_binary_sha256 currently hashes sys.executable while Piper package/runtime identity is only auxiliary and non-required.
terminal_blockers.repair: Require canonical identity of the actual Piper runtime/distribution artifact used for synthesis; keep interpreter identity auxiliary; fail closed if unresolved; bind runtime identity to exact waveform lineage.

terminal_blockers.problem: The predeclared max-inflight bound is derived from fixed quantum/rate policy before relevant reported graph/node/stream latency is causally included, while later latency evidence cannot justify the earlier threshold.
terminal_blockers.repair: Use a pre-cancel read-only latency snapshot or equivalent causally prior evidence to derive a conservative fixed bound from the maximum relevant admitted latency terms plus fixed safety policy; fail closed on missing/unparseable or later-exceeded assumptions instead of emitting PRODUCT_NEGATIVE.

terminal_blockers.problem: The discriminator creates the run-owned PipeWire null sink/monitor itself, yet cleanup_ok=false is currently classified as PRODUCT_NEGATIVE even though current G2 scope does not establish a production playback executor that owns this synthetic graph.
terminal_blockers.repair: Keep cleanup required and fail-closed, but classify synthetic harness cleanup/identity failure as EVIDENCE_INVALID (or infra when execution/graph teardown itself is unavailable). Reserve PRODUCT_NEGATIVE for a separately bound product-owned cleanup invariant that Frankenstein itself actually executes.

terminal_blockers.problem: The analyzer excludes windows that start before the declared bound from post-bound checking while allowing BOUNDED_TAIL an extra +window_ms margin, so an old-audio-correlated window can straddle the bound and still satisfy terminal PASS.
terminal_blockers.repair: Add a dedicated post-bound-only correlation scan beginning exactly at ceil(bound_end_ms * sample_rate / 1000) and require zero old-packet correlation there; remove the implicit +window_ms semantic extension or fail closed on unresolved boundary-resolution uncertainty.

terminal_blockers.problem: cancel_offset_ms is measured from paplay process Popen time and then interpreted directly as a source-waveform frame/time. Source-to-monitor PCM alignment does not bind process launch to source frame 0, while playback queuing/buffering/graph delay can shift those timelines.
terminal_blockers.repair: Bind the causal cancel instant to an observed exact playback-stream/source position (using a documented stream-timing primitive such as pw_stream_get_time_n or an equivalent exact read-only timing surface) and persist the monotonic-to-source-frame mapping. If unavailable, fail closed rather than classifying source windows from Popen time.

single_repair_rule: Fold all five blockers into the existing G2 evidence/helper/guard/analyzer/launcher path in one smallest coherent descendant. Do not create a second observer, analyzer, acceptance authority, playback authority, Voice authority, state authority or semantic generation.
required_regressions: Different Piper runtime manifests under the same Python interpreter produce distinct canonical runtime identity.
Missing Piper runtime identity fails terminal completeness even when interpreter hash is present.
Relevant pre-cancel reported latency above the old quantum-only threshold either enlarges the causally prior bound or fails closed before CANCEL.
Missing/unparseable pre-cancel latency evidence prevents terminal completeness.
A post-cancel latency observation that violates the frozen assumptions yields EVIDENCE_INVALID_BOUND_ASSUMPTION rather than retroactively moving the threshold or falsely asserting PRODUCT_NEGATIVE.

Synthetic run-owned sink/monitor persistence or ambiguous teardown evidence keeps terminal G2 NOT_ACCEPTED with zero measured credit but does not become PRODUCT_NEGATIVE absent a production cleanup invariant.
Old-packet correlation confined to the post-bound suffix of a window that starts before the bound cannot pass merely because the window start is pre-bound.
A straddling window whose post-bound suffix is silent is resolved by post-bound-only evidence rather than falsely classified PRODUCT_NEGATIVE.
Changing analyzer window_ms cannot silently widen the frozen semantic cancellation bound by the same amount.
Injected playback-client startup delay must not shift the measured cancel source-frame position when stream/sample progression is unchanged.
Missing exact playback stream/source-position timing must prevent terminal completeness even when PCM correlation is green.
The cancel monotonic-to-source-frame mapping must bind the same exact playback stream/object lineage used by the G2 PipeWire receipt.
Existing replacement-readback, H4 coverage, causal cancel delivery, object identity and zero-credit fences remain green.
